sections.title: 01 / Protocol Architecture & Vision
sections.summary: Inc.hood is a decentralized yield-incubator bridging Real-World Assets (RWA) with 2-hour automated synthetic lifecycle pods.
key_points: Non-custodial RWA exposure via algorithmically backed incubation pods.
Aggregated public pool mechanics with real-time on-chain proof of state.
Zero individual account silos — shared public ledger with wallet-verified asset allocation.

sections.title: 02 / INC 2-Hour Cycle & Burn Split Mechanics
sections.summary: Mathematical model governing every incubation pod cycle.

metrics.yield_return_split: 75% allocated directly to reward pool & wallet claims
metrics.automated_burn_split: 25% permanently incinerated from total INC token supply

sections.formula: Yield Distribution = Pool Deposit * (1 + Base_RWA_Yield) * [75% Claimable + 25% Permanent Burn]

sections.title: 03 / Asset Universe & Synthetic RWAs
sections.description: Pods are tethered to top-tier institutional and equity underlying assets.

sections.title: 04 / Rarity Tier Presentation & Drop Rates
sections.description: Randomized RWA nominal value distribution calculated upon pod cycle completion.

sections.title: 05 / Real EVM Wallet Connection Architecture
sections.summary: Protocol requirement for starting pod cycles and claiming allocations.
steps: User clicks Start Pod or Connect Wallet.
Injected Provider Check (MetaMask / Coinbase / EVM Browser Wallet).
Active Wallet Address & Network verification (EVM Chain ID 1/8453/42161).
Public protocol state updates instantly with connected address holdings.

items.q: How does the 2-hour incubation period execute?
items.a: Pods run on a synchronized 7200-second timer. At cycle end, reward calculations execute automatically, revealing RWA asset tier allocations.

items.q: Are rewards bound to individual login accounts?
items.a: No. Inc.hood operates as a public protocol without individual account logins. All holdings and reward records belong directly to the connected EVM cryptographic wallet address.

items.q: How is the 25% token burn handled?
items.a: 25% of the total pod yield input is routed directly to the zero burn address (0x000...0000) during cycle settlement, decreasing total protocol circulating supply.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Add '/docs' route in Layout navigation bar next to Protocol, visible to all web visitors from the home page.

2. Implement the comprehensive Docs page with Swiss technical layout: Architecture, 2h Cycle/25% burn mechanics, Asset Universe, Rarity Tier & Drop Rate Table ($1-$10 Common 60%, $10-$30 Rare 25%, $30-$100 Epic 11%, $100-$500 Legendary 4%), Real Wallet Connect guide, and FAQ.
3. Implement Real EVM Wallet Connection before Buy/Start using window.ethereum provider if available, or simulated address binding if non-injected, persisting state in local store.
4. Add Shareable & Downloadable Inc.hood Reward Card modal/component with PNG download canvas and copy permalink action for community sharing.
5. Ensure NO second-person wording ('your', 'you', 'my') is visible in visible UI copy — use public protocol and wallet framing ('Protocol Cycle', 'Wallet Holdings', 'Claimed Allocation').
6. Do NOT display demo/sandbox/no-real-token disclaimers in visible UI.
7. Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, links, modals, inputs, and card elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Maintain Inc.hood graphite black (#0B0D0C) and chartreuse green (#B9F477) aesthetic with 1px dark green grid borders.
All interactive elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Do NOT center align main container or app root.
Transitions must be specific to properties (color, background-color, border-color, opacity) and NEVER transition: all.
